body:
Hi @chrisvidal before I can answer you more I would be interested in seeing what you are building. We have very little examples of multi index search with instantsearch.js and to be able to build the right set of API we would like to know more/see your current interface.

Do you think you can share it with us? Mabe via support if it's currently not public: support@algolia.com (mention instantsearch.js, this issues and Vincent)
